required_fields: Clinical phenotypes reported in affected individuals with LRRC7 variants (OMIM #621415), including numerator and denominator counts per cohort, original paper wording, standard HPO term, and paper PMID/DOI citation

Most discriminating findings that are present in most affected individuals but uncommon in disorders commonly confused with this condition, including names of those differential disorders and confidence in the distinction
Findings looked for and found absent in affected individuals whose presence argues against the diagnosis
Phenotype differences correlated with variant type, variant position, age, or sex
Contradictory findings reported between different papers
